decisions.statement: A show answers the records kept beside this agent's page for the subagents under it.
The arguments a show takes are read from standard input.
The arguments are read by the reader `akasha change` reads its arguments with.
A call piping nothing in is refused rather than run with no argument.
The key `at` names the path shown.
A key other than `at` is refused rather than passed over.
A path is read against the repository root here.
A path outside the repository is refused.
A call naming no path is refused rather than answering every record.
A path naming no record is refused rather than answered with nothing.
Every record at the path named is answered rather than the first alone.
A record is opened by the subagent that left it, the time the seat took it, and what it does.
A record changing a body answers the text drafted against and the text that record would leave.
A record adding or appending answers the body that record carries.
A record carrying no body answers its opening line alone.
A record whose line reads as no edit is reached by no path.
An answer past what one answer holds is refused rather than broken off partway.
The bytes one answer has are the bytes `akasha read` holds.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.
A text answered is not formatted.
No text answered is recorded as read against the calling agent.
A show writes nothing.
No flag other than the help flag is said on the command line.
The help flag is answered with what a show answers and what a show takes.

definition: the command answering whole the records a seat keeps at one path
